title: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A knight and sorceress of Eldraine's royal family who searches the wilds for a cure for the Wicked Slumber and dreams of her dead parents.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young half-fae hero on a quest for Talion, wielding a pair of fae-made basket hilts, who befriends Ruby.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A clever girl in a red cloak with a deadly apple throw who helps Kellan find a witch's cabin and searches for her brother.

entities.name: Peter
entities.description: Ruby's brother, a woodsman enchanted by a witch's song into hunting Ruby and Kellan in wolf armor.

entities.name: Royse
entities.description: A weaver with eight eyes and eight arms hidden beneath her human glamor, who shelters Rowan and points her to a castle.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The Faerie Lord who directs Kellan's quest, giving him the hilts and naming Hylda as the next witch.

entities.name: Linden
entities.description: Rowan's stepmother, who appears in her dream.

entities.name: Rowan's father
entities.description: The dead king who appears in Rowan's dream, giving her his crown.

entities.name: Duncan
entities.description: A man in Edgewall who sends Kellan to a pie shop.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: The next witch Kellan must seek, hidden from Talion's eyes.

entities.name: Gerra Grandsquall
entities.description: A figure who tore the mirror Indrelon from Castle Vantress.

entities.name: Wolf Knight's witchstalkers
entities.description: Wolf-like beasts that attack magical creatures and chase off the Wolf Knight.

entities.name: Pixies
entities.description: Mischievous fae creatures that laugh at Ruby and Kellan.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose hacked-apart corpses dot the countryside.

entities.name: The Wicked Slumber
entities.description: The sleeping curse that spreads by touch and halted the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: A mirror that may reveal Hylda, far from Castle Vantress, atop a beanstalk.

entities.name: Basket hilts
entities.description: Fae-wrought hilts of living wood given to Kellan by Talion that fly back to his hand when thrown.

entities.name: Cauldron
entities.description: The witch's cauldron that Peter carries to Talion's court.

entities.name: Edgewall
entities.description: A bustling Eldraine town where Kellan first looks for witches.

entities.name: Dunbarrow
entities.description: A forest region where witches live and Ruby's brother knows every inch.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: The royal castle where Rowan's father tells her her blood awaits.

entities.name: Talion's court
entities.description: The fae realm reached through the cauldron's threshold.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The fairy-tale plane.

events.summary: Rowan stays with Royse the weaver, who reveals her true eight-eyed form and directs her to an ancient castle.
events.quote: revealing eight eyes, two chittering mandibles, eight arms hidden beneath her stole.

events.summary: Rowan finds the castle's library empty and collapses in rage and tears.
events.quote: Alone in the abandoned castle, Rowan Kenrith becomes a storm.

events.summary: Rowan dreams of a feast where her parents give her their crown and tell her to come to Castle Ardenvale; she wakes resolved to go.
events.quote: "Come to Castle Ardenvale. Your blood awaits you there."

events.summary: Kellan asks around Edgewall for witches and is warned by Ruby not to touch a sleeper because of the Wicked Slumber.
events.quote: "The Wicked Slumber spreads, though no one's really sure how,"

events.summary: Ruby agrees to guide Kellan to Dunbarrow in exchange for help finding her brother Peter, after he vaguely names his fae liege.
events.quote: "All right. I guess someone's got to look out for you, and it might as well be me."

events.summary: On the way they pass Phyrexian remnants and Ruby throws an apple at a laughing pixie.
events.quote: Ruby picks up an apple from her basket and flings it hard as a giant flinging a boulder

events.summary: A wolf-armored archer attacks, and Kellan and Ruby flee.
events.quote: The Wolf Knight strides toward them.

events.summary: Ruby leads Kellan through a pack of witchstalkers, who then chase off the Wolf Knight.
events.quote: The Wolf Knight runs into the woods as the witchstalkers give chase.

events.summary: They find a witch's thorny cabin and overhear her song about eating a knight.
events.quote: "When I was hungry a knight wandered in, wild at heart and covered in tin ..."

events.summary: Kellan sneaks in and charges the witch, knocking her into her cauldron.
events.quote: he hears her scream as she falls into the cauldron

events.summary: The Wolf Knight arrives, but when Ruby calls him Peter he removes his helm; it is her brother who was enchanted by the witch.
Peter helps carry the cauldron through a threshold to Talion's court, where Talion names Hylda as the next witch and the mirror Indrelon as the way to find her.
events.quote: "But consult the mirror Indrelon, and you may yet find her ."

events.summary: Ruby learns Kellan's liege is the fae king and decides to keep helping him.
events.quote: "You helped me find my brother, so I'll help.

relations.quote: If you see my brother, tell him Ruby's waiting for him back at home.

relations.note: Kellan is on a quest for Talion
relations.quote: But they're helping me find my father.

relations.note: Ruby decides to help him on his quest
relations.quote: I guess someone's got to look out for you
"I have promised you shelter and given you food; we are not enemies."

relations.note: Rowan's stepmother appears in the dream
Peter offers to grant whatever Kellan asks and carries the cauldron
relations.quote: Whatever you ask of me, only speak it, and I will grant it

relations.note: Kellan's hilts are Talion's parting gift

relations.quote: The Wolf Knight runs into the woods as the witchstalkers give chase.

relations.note: Gerra tore the mirror from Castle Vantress
relations.quote: Torn from Castle Vantress by Gerra Grandsquall

relations.note: Edgewall is a town in the Realm
relations.quote: There are so many people in Edgewall.
